# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary analysis documents produced during the application assessment of **ZavaAuthGateway** — a .NET Framework 4.8 ASP.NET Web Forms authentication gateway for the ZavaBank platform.

## Supplementary Documents

| Document | Description |
|---|---|
| [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) | Application architecture diagram showing technology layers, data flow, and component relationships. Includes Technology Stack Summary, Data Storage & External Services, and Component Inventory. |
| [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) | Visual map of all external dependencies grouped by functional category. Covers version and compatibility risks, notable observations, and test dependency inventory. |
| [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) | Catalog of all HTTP endpoints, DTOs, communication patterns, security posture, and a sequence diagram of primary request flows. |
| [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) | Database configuration, entity model (ER diagram), repository methods, caching strategy, data ownership boundaries, and data classification/sensitivity analysis. |
| [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) | Comprehensive inventory of all configuration sources, build/runtime profiles, properties, secrets, feature flags, startup dependency chain, and framework versions. |
| [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) | Core business workflows (login, logout, token validation, identity lookup), domain entities, business rules, and a sequence diagram of the primary authentication flow. |
